ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/light-grey) and 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) localized primarily in the central peduncle insertion area and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity triangular region at the fluke base. Extensive multi-scale dark circular mottling distributed across both lobes. Dense dark pixel clusters concentrated along the trailing edge and outer distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree pixel angle and vertical depth roughly 1/6th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Notable macro-indentations (chips) on the right lobe (viewer perspective) between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral S-curve; concave curvature initiating from the median notch transitioning to convex curvature towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular ring-shaped clusters (barnacle scars) detected across both lobes. High-density grouping in the mid-left and mid-right fluke regions, appearing as dark rings on light backgrounds and light rings on dark backgrounds.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical and diagonal low-intensity linear disruptions observed on the upper-right lobe surface and outer left lobe margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular chipping and potential tissue loss on the right-side trailing edge. White calcareous deposits (live barnacles) visible on the superior distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ring-within-ring' scar patterns located in the lower central dark region near the notch.
